pages.text: Androids need a Lua role program to enable combat before using NTGL weapons. NTGL handles aiming and ammunition. Reload: $(bold)/androidscompat reload$().
Armor is equipped automatically. Curios and Sophisticated Backpacks have optional support. Orders: hold, patrol, guard, follow <player>, rescue, logistics and return.
Use $(bold)/androidscompat order <order>$() for the nearest Android; add all to affect nearby units. Compatible enemies from other mods can also be targeted.
